entries.title: Architecture decision records
entries.description: Every change to how DOC is built starts as an ADR in `docs/adr`.

entries.title: Spikes before decisions
entries.description: An ADR that is uncertain is tried first under `spikes/`, and the spike is kept after the decision.

entries.title: One process per plugin
entries.description: Every feature is a plugin in a process of its own, which registers with the backend and can be hot-reloaded without the rest noticing.

entries.title: Server-rendered pages
entries.description: Pages are HTML from the server, made interactive with htmx; there is no single-page app to build.

entries.title: Raft-replicated buses
entries.description: The Event, Service and Cache Buses are three-node Raft clusters; development runs them in memory instead.

entries.title: Sign-in accounts in configuration files
entries.description: Usernames and password hashes kept in `[auth.local]`.

timeline.description: No longer read: people sign in with DOC accounts, which the `local` plugin keeps.

entries.title: PostgreSQL
entries.description: Core's schemas and every plugin's collections, in two databases. Version 17.

entries.title: Docker Compose
entries.description: How DOC runs on one machine: `just up` starts storage, fabric, core, workers and plugins in that order.

entries.title: Kubernetes
entries.description: Manifests for DOC's system and its plugins are in `deploy/kubernetes`.

entries.title: Grafana LGTM
entries.description: Traces, metrics and logs from every part of DOC, with DOC's dashboards, in one container beside the stack.

entries.title: just
entries.description: Every way of building, checking and running DOC is a recipe in the `justfile`.

entries.title: cargo-watch
entries.description: `just dev` rebuilds and restarts the backend, frontend, workers and each plugin on every edit.

entries.title: cargo-deny
entries.description: Advisories and licences for every crate in the build, as part of `just check`.

entries.title: Mermaid
entries.description: The architecture snapshot's diagrams, rendered to PNGs by `just arch`.

entries.title: ccc
entries.description: Code maps and insights, run by the `insights` plugin over each repository after a merge.

entries.title: Rust
entries.description: Everything DOC runs is Rust, on the toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.

entries.title: axum
entries.description: The backend's HTTP API and the frontend.

entries.title: Askama
entries.description: Templates checked at compile time, for the frontend and every plugin's pages.

entries.title: htmx
entries.description: Vendored and checked against recorded hashes (`just verify-assets`).

entries.title: quiche
entries.description: HTTP/3 over QUIC between the backend, its plugins and the bus nodes.

entries.title: openraft
entries.description: The consensus under the three buses.

entries.title: OpenTelemetry
entries.description: Every part of DOC exports traces, metrics and logs over OTLP, and so does every service DOC's templates create.
